address: 7a Stoney Street, Borough Market, London, SE1 9AA, United Kingdom
bio: Situated on the edge of Borough Market, this vibrant taqueria mimics the area’s busy, buzzy atmosphere. It’s a characterful place inside, making the most of its railway-arch location with a zinc-lined, barrel-vaulted ceiling. The menu opens with a choice of ceviches, before moving on to a sharing-inclined selection of tacos, tostadas and quesadillas that are fresh, fragrant and spicy – such as the signature pork shoulder ‘Taco Al Pastor’ with grilled pineapple. Margarita fans will be in heaven with the wide array of creative takes....
